Izmayil Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Odes'ka oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Established in 1835, this cemetery survived vandalism during WWII and remained in use afterward — its last recorded burial came as late as 1969, unusually recent for this collection — before being demolished in 1970, with some gravestones relocated to Izmayil's newer cemetery. The Jewish community here, first mentioned in the 16th century, endured repeated pogroms (1872, 1905) and peaked above 4,300 by 1910; most of the wartime ghetto population was deported to Transnistria in October 1941, where the majority died. The former cemetery site, owned by the municipality, now functions as a waste dump.
